content.user_title: Analyze Options and Warrants with Longbridge
content.value_statement: Options and warrant analysis requires contract data, Greeks, volatility, and liquidity context. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Longbridge workflows for clear derivative snapshots.
actual_capabilities: Routes option quote, option chain, option volume, and HK warrant requests to the right reference workflow.
Explains OCC option symbols, strikes, expiries, call and put terms, and common Chinese market terms.
Guides analysis of Greeks, implied volatility, open interest, volume, and warrant quote fields.
Provides strategy frameworks for covered calls, protective puts, spreads, straddles, strangles, and iron condors.
Supports payoff, breakeven, max profit, max loss, and net Greeks summaries for option positions.
Covers volatility analysis, IV versus HV, skew, term structure, calendar spreads, and delta hedging.
limitations: It depends on Longbridge CLI or MCP tools being available in the user environment.
US options may require suitable Longbridge market access.
HK warrants are covered, but US warrants are outside the documented scope.
Outputs are educational analysis and must not be treated as investment advice.

use_cases.title: Review an Option Chain
use_cases.description: Find expiries, strikes, calls, puts, Greeks, volume, and open interest for a selected underlying.

use_cases.title: Compare Volatility Signals
use_cases.description: Use IV, HV, percentile estimates, smile shape, and skew to frame a volatility view.

use_cases.title: Evaluate HK Warrants
use_cases.description: List HK warrants, review issuer information, and compare quote fields such as leverage, IV, and premium.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Basic Option Chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the available option expiries and nearby strikes for [SYMBOL]. Include calls, puts, and the source used.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Contract Greeks
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of one option contract.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [OCC_SYMBOL]. Summarize premium, IV, delta, gamma, theta, vega, volume, and open interest in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Strategy Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: For [SYMBOL], I am [bullish/bearish/neutral] over [TIMEFRAME]. Compare two suitable option strategies with risks and tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Volatility and Skew
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate IV versus HV, term structure, and put-call skew for [SYMBOL]. Suggest what volatility strategies may fit the data.

output_examples.input: Show me near-term AAPL options and explain the closest strikes.
output_examples.output: A concise chain summary with expiries, nearby calls and puts, strike context, volume notes, and Longbridge as the source.

output_examples.input: Compare a bull call spread and covered call for 700.HK.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side strategy explanation covering structure, cost, capped upside, downside risk, liquidity concerns, and educational disclaimers.

output_examples.input: Check whether TSLA implied volatility looks rich or cheap.
output_examples.output: A volatility snapshot comparing ATM IV, 60-day HV, IV percentile proxy, skew, and possible strategy implications.

best_practices: Confirm the symbol, market, expiry, strike, and call or put direction before requesting contract data.
State the user's market view, time horizon, and risk tolerance before comparing strategies.
Include liquidity, max loss, breakeven, and educational disclaimers in every strategy response.
anti_patterns: Do not present strategy examples as personalized investment advice.
Do not use stale option chains when live Longbridge data is available.
Do not recommend short premium strategies without explaining unlimited or large loss risks.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It helps analyze options and warrants. It does not submit orders or manage accounts.

faq.question: Which markets are covered?
faq.answer: The references cover HK and US options data, plus HK warrants and CBBC products.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: The main option and warrant commands are documented as public. Some US market access may still be required.

faq.question: Can it explain Greeks?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers delta, gamma, theta, vega, and net Greeks for multi-leg positions.

faq.question: Can it evaluate volatility strategies?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide IV versus HV, skew, term structure, calendar spreads, and delta hedging analysis.

faq.question: Is the output financial advice?
faq.answer: No. The skill frames educational analysis and should include risk notes for independent decision making.
